observed_phase: live full-shape SS floorplan repair, not terminal
mechanism: Four existing modulo-2^32 status counters: four eight-bit local increments driven by three registered lower-byte all-ones predicates. After an increment, each predicate captures whether the old lower 8/16/24 bits equal all-ones minus one. Predicate and counter hold together otherwise and reset together. No transaction permission predicate is cached.
range_preserved: all32 bits including modulo wrap; no narrowing
exact_gate_required: one source-faithful writer config with golden cycle/identity/debt/negative/reset and byte/multi-byte/full32 wrap checks; meaningful broken-carry negative control
physical_required: actual full-shape SS60/FF25/833.333ps and allocated parent clock/load/slot context; no IO or reset waiver
